findings.evidence: The statement is `¬ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ ↦ -conj w) z`. Grepping Mathlib for not-differentiable conj lemmas finds only `DifferentiableAt.conj_conj` and `star_conj` in Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/Deriv/Star.lean, so no equivalent exists.
findings.fix: Move it to a general complex-analysis file as a public lemma, e.g. `Complex.not_differentiableAt_conj` with the negated form derived from it, and use that lemma here.
findings.issue: `private theorem not_differentiableAt_neg_conj` only talks about `ℂ` and does not depend on the bordered groupoid, so it is general infrastructure hidden as `private`.

findings.evidence: The only lemma about the new instance is `euclideanHalfSpaceChartedSpace_chartAt` (`:= rfl`); there is no atlas lemma, and the manifold proof destructures the atlas image by definitional unfolding.
findings.fix: Add an atlas lemma, e.g. `euclideanHalfSpaceChartedSpace_atlas : atlas (EuclideanHalfSpace 2) M = (· ≫ₕ euclideanHalfSpaceHomeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph) '' atlas ClosedUpperHalfPlane M` and/or a `mem_atlas` iff, and use it in `isManifold_euclideanHalfSpace`. Prove `euclideanHalfSpaceChartedSpace_chartAt` with `(rfl)`.
findings.issue: `euclideanHalfSpaceChartedSpace` has a lemma for `chartAt` but none saying which charts are in its atlas. `isManifold_euclideanHalfSpace` has to unfold the `@[expose]` body to get at the atlas (`rintro _ _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ ⟨c', hc', rfl⟩`), so other users will have to as well.

findings.evidence: Grep shows `interiorHolomorphicPregroupoid` is used only in BorderedHolomorphic.lean, and line 133 declares the property iff `private theorem`.
findings.fix: Either make the pregroupoid private, since users go through `mem_borderedHolomorphicGroupoid_iff`, or keep it public and make a characterization of `.property` public alongside it.
findings.issue: `ClosedUpperHalfPlane.interiorHolomorphicPregroupoid` is public, but the only lemma describing its property (`interiorHolomorphicPregroupoid_property_iff`) is private. Users get a public definition with no public way to reason about it.

summary: A general lemma about ℂ is hidden as `private`, the new native-coordinate charted space has no lemma describing its atlas, and the public helper pregroupoid has no public lemma describing its property.
